subject.title: feat(workboard): review gate hard blocks + workboard_submit_review tool

question: Should Workboard accept a durable `ready_to_merge` status and fail-closed completion gate as the review lifecycle, or should the review gate be modeled with existing statuses?
rationale: The PR changes persisted Workboard state and existing completion behavior, so maintainers need to choose the lifecycle contract before automation can safely repair the implementation details.

options.title: Repair the new lifecycle before merge
options.body: Keep the new review lifecycle direction but require the PR to preserve the existing completion envelope, block every no-review completion path, declare the new tool/status, update consumers/tests, and supply real behavior proof.

options.title: Redesign without `ready_to_merge`
options.body: If maintainers do not want another durable status, have the contributor model review approval using existing Workboard statuses and metadata before continuing.

options.title: Accept with upgrade proof
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept the fail-closed lifecycle and status expansion, but should require explicit upgrade behavior proof for existing Workboard users.

recommendation.title: Repair the new lifecycle before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the new review lifecycle direction but require the PR to preserve the existing completion envelope, block every no-review completion path, declare the new tool/status, update consumers/tests, and supply real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The Workboard plugin and orchestration lifecycle were introduced and expanded in PRs authored and merged by this owner, making them the best available product-direction owner.
